text.tspan: 04 · Decision: health checker driving FRR (A), same on every node
Resolver node (identical build on-prem and in AWS)
every 2 s: query a test name
Fail-closed paths: resolver fails → checker withdraws (~5 s) · checker dies or hangs → systemd withdraws ·
FRR or host dies → BGP session drops (BFD < 1 s on-prem, hold timer ≤ 30 s in AWS)
